extDescription.message: Close idle tabs, group tabs from the same site, and remember URLs on this computer.

openSummary.description: Popup summary when some tabs can be closed.

openSummaryQuiet.description: Popup summary when no tabs will be closed.

sortWindow.description: Button that groups the current window.

closeIdle.description: Button that closes idle tabs once.

restore.description: Button that opens a saved URL.

forget.description: Button that deletes one saved URL.

emptyMemory.message: Closed pages stay here, on this computer only.

noMatches.message: No saved pages match that search.

inactiveHoursHint.message: The clock starts when you last open the tab. Tabs already open at install start from that moment, so nothing is closed in a rush.

minOpenTabs.message: Always keep at least this many tabs

maxClosePerSweep.message: Close at most this many each pass

groupByDomain.message: Group a service with its test and testsite hosts

whitelistHint.message: One domain per line. example.com also keeps its subdomains. docs.example.com keeps only that site.

clearArchive.description: Button that deletes every saved URL.

clearConfirm.message: Clear every URL TabPerch has remembered? Chrome history is left as it is.

keptOpen.message: $REST$ more idle tabs stay for now. Each pass closes at most $MAX$, and at least $MIN$ tabs stay open.
keptOpen.description: Explains why not every idle tab closes at once.

pendingNotice.message: $COUNT$ tabs just perched. You can reopen them below.

pendingNoticeOne.message: 1 tab just perched. You can reopen it below.

previewBanner.message: Interface preview. TabPerch can manage real tabs after it is loaded in Chrome.
previewBanner.description: Shown when the page is opened outside Chrome.

moreResults.message: $COUNT$ more. Narrow the search to see them.
moreResults.description: Shown when the memory list is truncated.

sortedFlash.message: This window is grouped by site.

closedFlash.message: Perched $COUNT$ tabs. The URLs are in memory.

closedFlashOne.message: Perched 1 tab. The URL is in memory.
closedFlashOne.description: Confirmation after closing one idle tab.

restoreBatch.description: Button to reopen the last perched batch.

willPerch.description: Preview of idle tabs that will close.

intro.message: URLs stay in this browser. TabPerch has no account and does not send them anywhere.

idleNone.description: Shown when a manual sweep closes nothing.
